name: tinto-add-destination
description: Creating the Destinations table row that Tours falls back to (Hero Image(s), Gallery, Overview, What's Included, Hotel Name/Description/Photos, and so on) when a genuinely new destination is confirmed, closing tinto-add-new-tour's former dead end there. Dedupes first, then sets Location to the exact string Tours.Location will use (matched by plain text, not a linked field). Also fills Arrival City and four seasonal Packing/Weather Tip fields that the Mid-Trip guest email reads directly, auto-drafted for Nélia's review. Frames Overview/What's Included and Hero Image(s)/Gallery asks around exactly where they show on the booking page, with a real example shown for the first and an explicit horizontal-orientation and Dropbox-link ask for the second; web-sources photos from explicitly free/royalty-free stock sites when the client has none of their own, writes candidates before sharing the record link for review, and rejects any photo whose claimed location isn't visually corroborated by the image itself. Generates Overview Map SVG/Caption from real public geographic boundary data in the established house style, with a labeled pin for each base city. Deliberately does not touch Tours.Location's dropdown choices (left to tinto-add-new-tour's own typecast write when the first real tour there is created).
